clientLogicTests.scope: Cloud tools, mirrors, community download routing, legacy staging, local path routing, version and update identity

serverTests.scope: Offline temporary databases and synthetic network/PE/ZIP fixtures; no vendor programs executed

nativeUi.scope: Default owned catalog, source selection, visible installable cards, loading and installed status; isolated data and rejected network

limits: File-level verification is not application startup, dependency, installer completion, login, licensing, or nationwide connectivity verification. Main client version stays 0.1.1; dated candidate and source changes do not silently replace the existing published package.
